scope: Independent final read of drafts and archive for each Poste account, followed by global duplicate comparison

coverage.scope: Seven backend and four worker runtime files, including prior duplicate/retry changes; coverage data files isolated per process

invariants: One queued read job per available normalized account
Concurrent start requests produce a single run (real PostgreSQL test)
Existing exclusive per-account lease and login workflow reused
Draft and archive reads must both finish all pages
Proof is bound to run, job, account and interval
Only evidence from the requested run is accepted
Same shipment id on one account moving to archive is counted once
Same id on different accounts and drafts without ids remain distinct
Missing and misplaced expected notices are reported
No portal creation, deletion or INVIA; item states unchanged
limitations: Explicit start after operations finish; no automatic trigger added
Any pending/queued_resume/processing Poste job blocks start, including manually paused jobs
Portal reads are not atomic across accounts; external manual changes require a new read
Only GAIA shipment names are compared, not PDF content or arbitrary manual names
After 30 minutes a new read is needed to certify current state
test_harness_notes: A combined worker process failed 10 browser tests because existing test_posta_online_client globally stubs playwright.async_api. All 10 passed in an isolated process; no unrelated tests were changed.
Initial worker run skipped six PostgreSQL cases because POSTE_TEST_DATABASE_URL was missing; all six subsequently passed using the disposable local PostgreSQL container.
Early concurrent coverage runs used the shared default data file; final isolated coverage artifacts supersede them.
